components.label: Trend: price vs 200-day average
components.why: Above the 200-day average is bullish, below is bearish (saturates around +/-30 %).

components.label: Weekly RSI momentum (50-line)
components.why: Cardwell: weekly RSI holding above 50 (bull range 40-80) = bullish; below 50 (bear range 20-60) = bearish. +1 at 70, -1 at 30.

components.label: Daily RSI momentum (50-line)
components.why: Same 50-line read on the daily chart, lower weight (more noise).

components.label: Exhaustion overlay (never positive)
components.why: Penalty when weekly RSI is 75-85+ and/or price is stretched past the 90th-99th percentile of its own distance-from-200d history.

components.label: Capitulation overlay (never negative)
components.why: Bonus when price sits in the bottom ~15 % of its own distance-from-200d history (washed-out zone).

components.label: Swing phase (last confirmed pivot)
components.why: Up-phase after a confirmed >=35 % rally off a low, down-phase after a confirmed >=35 % drop from a top.

edge.reading: Bullish states did slightly better than bearish states, but the gap is small and unreliable.
